{"command": "python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img14 = Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0014.png")
arr14 = np.array(img14)
mask = (arr14[:, :, 2] > 150) & (arr14[:, :, 0] < 50) & (arr14[:, :, 1] < 100)
y14, x14 = np.where(mask)
print(f"Blue object in obs_0014: x range [{x14.min()}, {x14.max()}], center_x = {x14.mean():.1f}")
print(f"y range [{y14.min()}, {y14.max()}], bottom_y = {y14.max()}")
'", "description": "Find blue object coordinates in obs_0014"}
